note: Task import now takes MS Project schedules directly. Drop an Excel .xlsx file straight into Import (no more saving as CSV first) and the app reads it in the browser. An MS Project export is auto-detected: the app builds the WBS from the Outline Level, reads the Duration, and converts the row-number predecessors (like "4SS") into real task links, then runs the CPM schedule so every linked task is dated from its predecessors and summaries roll up. A normal CSV or a filled-in template (as .csv or .xlsx) still imports exactly as before.
